description.value:
Trigger A creature within range Casts a Spell or performs an action with the auditory trait. You interrupt a creature's speech with a censoring emoji resembling a speaker with a line through it or a giant red X around its mouth or speakers. The triggering creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] until the end of your next turn.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} and off-guard for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 3} and off-guard for 1 minute.
